### Rūgščių ir bazių chemija

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[acidBaseChemistry.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Acid–base chemistry concerns proton transfer, electron-pair interactions, acidity, and the behavior of chemical systems under relevant conditions. Its models, solution properties, transformations and analytical methods are broader than reaction-pattern classification alone.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk rūgščių ir bazių sąveiką bei rūgštingumo aprašymą ir matavimą.

#### Rūgščių ir bazių pagrindai

Skills: 3

[acidBaseFundamentals.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/acidBaseFundamentals.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Conceptual acid–base models establish what counts as an acid or base, while strength and pH describe different aspects of chemical behavior and solution conditions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask rūgščių ir bazių modelius, rūgštingumą ir rūgšties stiprumą.

##### Rūgščių ir bazių modeliai

[acidBaseModels.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/skills/acidBaseModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish common Arrhenius, Brønsted–Lowry and Lewis descriptions by the chemical interactions each includes.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Palygink, kaip įprasti modeliai apibrėžia rūgštis ir bazes.

##### Rūgščių stiprumas

[acidStrength.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/skills/acidStrength.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how strongly an acid tends to donate a proton under specified conditions. A stronger acid transfers protons more readily in a comparable system; this does not mean the solution is necessarily more concentrated or more hazardous.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atskirk rūgšties stiprumą nuo tirpalo koncentracijos ar pavojingumo.

##### pH

[pH.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseFundamentals/skills/pH.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a logarithmic measure of hydrogen-ion activity and its concentration-based approximations.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask pH kaip logaritminį tirpalo rūgštingumo matą.

Skills: 4

[acidBaseSystems.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/acidBaseSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Neutralization, indicator responses, buffer equilibria and titration exemplify how acid–base behavior is observed, controlled and measured under specific conditions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip reaguoja rūgštys ir bazės bei kaip matuojamas jų poveikis.

[acidBaseIndicators.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/skills/acidBaseIndicators.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why some compounds change observable properties as solution acidity varies.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kaip keičiantis rūgštingumui kinta indikatorių išvaizda.

##### Rūgščių ir bazių titravimas

[acidBaseTitration.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/skills/acidBaseTitration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use a measured equivalence relationship to infer an unknown amount or concentration.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok titravimo matavimus nežinomam kiekiui nustatyti.

##### Buferiniai tirpalai

[bufferSolutions.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/skills/bufferSolutions.data.ts)

[neutralization.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/acidBaseChemistry/acidBaseSystems/skills/neutralization.data.ts)

### Atomai ir periodiškumas

Groups: 5 · Skills: 21

[atomsAndPeriodicity.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomsAndPeriodicity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The organization and electronic structure of atoms underpin elemental identity, isotopes, ions and recurring chemical behavior. This domain describes atomic constituents and trends; bond formation is treated separately.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk atomų viduje esančias daleles ir dėsningumus, siejančius cheminius elementus.

#### Atomo sandara

Skills: 4

[atomicStructure.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomicStructure/atomicStructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical element identity is determined by proton number; other atomic characteristics vary independently.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kas lemia cheminio elemento tapatybę ir kuo gali skirtis to paties elemento atomai.

##### Atominė masė

[atomicMass.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomicStructure/skills/atomicMass.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret atomic mass and relative atomic mass, including why a tabulated average may not be a whole number.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kodėl vidutinė atominė masė ne visada yra sveikasis skaičius.

##### Elektronai ir krūvis

[electronsAndCharge.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomicStructure/skills/electronsAndCharge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate electron gain or loss to ionic charge while preserving an element's identity.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kaip praradus ar prisijungus elektronų keičiasi atomo krūvis.

##### Neutronai ir izotopai

[neutronsAndIsotopes.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomicStructure/skills/neutronsAndIsotopes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate neutron count to isotopic identity without treating isotopes as different elements.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kodėl to paties elemento izotopuose skiriasi neutronų skaičius.

##### Protonai ir atominis skaičius

[protonsAndAtomicNumber.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/atomicStructure/skills/protonsAndAtomicNumber.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use proton count to establish elemental identity and locate an element in the periodic table.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Nustatyk cheminį elementą pagal protonų skaičių.

#### Elektroninė sandara

Skills: 5

[electronicStructure.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/electronicStructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electron occupancy and energetic organization help explain reactivity and the behavior of valence electrons.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip išsidėstę elektronai ir kodėl tai veikia cheminį elgesį.

##### Atominės orbitalės

[atomicOrbitals.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/skills/atomicOrbitals.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret orbitals as probability-based descriptions of electron states and their occupancy rather than fixed electron trajectories.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask orbitales kaip sritis, aprašomas elektrono buvimo tikimybe.

##### Elektronų konfigūracijos

[electronConfigurations.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/skills/electronConfigurations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Represent electron occupation for atoms and ions, respecting the applicable filling rules and exceptions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Pavaizduok, kaip elektronai užima būsenas atomuose ir jonuose.

[electronShells.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/skills/electronShells.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use shell organization and principal energy levels to explain patterns of electron distribution without treating shells as literal paths of electrons.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Aiškink dėsningumus elektronų sluoksniais, bet neįsivaizduok jų kaip pastovių planetų orbitų.

##### Jonų susidarymas

[ionFormation.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/skills/ionFormation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Predict plausible monatomic ion charges from electron gain or loss while recognizing chemical context.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Numatyk įprastus jonų krūvius atsižvelgdamas į cheminę aplinką.

[valenceElectrons.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/electronicStructure/skills/valenceElectrons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use outer-electron arrangements to reason about common chemical behavior and bonding possibilities.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink elementų reakcijų panašumus remdamasis išoriniais elektronais.

#### Branduolinė chemija

Skills: 4

[nuclearChemistry.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/nuclearChemistry/nuclearChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Changes within atomic nuclei alter nuclide identities rather than ordinary electron bonding. The chemical emphasis is isotopic substances, decay and analytical applications; general nuclear-force physics belongs to Physics.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kuo atomų branduolių pokyčiai skiriasi nuo įprastų cheminių reakcijų.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask pusėjimo trukmę kaip daugelio radioaktyviųjų atomų dėsningumą, o ne vieno atomo laikrodį.

[isotopeTracers.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/nuclearChemistry/skills/isotopeTracers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how detectable isotopic signatures can trace material pathways or provide chemical analytical evidence.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip izotopai padeda sekti medžiagas vykstant cheminiams procesams.

[nuclearTransmutation.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/atomsAndPeriodicity/nuclearChemistry/skills/nuclearTransmutation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Account for changes in proton and nucleon number across nuclear reactions and decays.

### Cheminiai ryšiai ir sandara

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[bondingAndStructure.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/bondingAndStructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical properties arise partly from how atoms and ions are connected and how neighboring particles interact. This domain distinguishes intraparticle bonds from interactions between particles and from bulk structural arrangements.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip cheminiai ryšiai ir trauka tarp dalelių lemia medžiagų savybes.

[chemicalBonds.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/bondingAndStructure/chemicalBonds/chemicalBonds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different electron distributions support different limiting models of chemical bonding; real substances can have mixed characteristics.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk, kaip atomai ir jonai, turėdami skirtingą elektronų išsidėstymą, sudaro cheminius ryšius.

**Methodological description (English):** Use electronegativity differences to characterize unequal electron sharing without equating every polar bond with a polar molecule.

### Cheminis tyrinėjimas

[chemicalInquiry.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/chemicalInquiry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analytical chemistry identifies particular components in samples and determines their amounts. Sample treatment, chemical selectivity and calibration govern whether signals justify a conclusion; general observation and bulk property comparison are distinct competencies.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip chemikai nustato medžiagas ir išmatuoja jų kiekius mėginiuose.

Skills: 4

[laboratoryReasoning.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/laboratoryReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Working with substances involves controlling exposure, maintaining traceability of samples and drawing conclusions that do not exceed the evidence.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Išmok saugiai dirbti su medžiagomis ir daryti pagrįstas išvadas.

##### Sprendimai dėl cheminių medžiagų tvarkymo

[chemicalHandlingDecisions.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/skills/chemicalHandlingDecisions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose risk-appropriate handling and disposal principles from substance identity, concentration and safety information rather than assuming familiar products are harmless.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Pasirink saugaus tvarkymo principus pagal medžiagos informaciją ir sąlygas.

##### Cheminių pavojų simboliai

[chemicalHazardSymbols.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/skills/chemicalHazardSymbols.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret common chemical hazard pictograms and distinguish hazard from actual exposure and risk.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink cheminių pavojų piktogramas ir suprask, kad rizika priklauso nuo poveikio.

##### Įrodymais pagrįstos cheminės išvados

[evidenceBasedChemicalConclusions.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/skills/evidenceBasedChemicalConclusions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate whether observations justify a claim about composition or reaction, including alternative explanations.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Įvertink, ar cheminiai stebėjimai tikrai pagrindžia siūlomą paaiškinimą.

##### Eksperimento kintamieji

[experimentalVariables.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/laboratoryReasoning/skills/experimentalVariables.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the manipulated chemical condition, observed response and controlled conditions in an investigation.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Kontroliuojamame eksperimente nustatyk, kuri cheminė sąlyga keičiama, kas matuojama ir kurios sąlygos palaikomos pastovios.

#### Matavimai ir įrodymai

Skills: 5

[measurementsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/measurementsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical conclusions depend on measured quantities, recorded conditions and the distinction between observed patterns and explanatory claims.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip matavimai ir kruopštus stebėjimas pagrindžia cheminius paaiškinimus.

##### Cheminių duomenų interpretavimas

[chemicalDataInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/skills/chemicalDataInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use tables and graphs to relate changing composition, time, temperature or measured property to chemical behavior.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok cheminius duomenis ryšiams tarp sąlygų ir rezultatų tirti.

##### Matavimo neapibrėžtis

[measurementUncertainty.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/skills/measurementUncertainty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the precision and uncertainty of experimental measurements rather than treating every reported digit as exact.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kodėl matuojamoms reikšmėms būdinga neapibrėžtis, o ne visiškas tikslumas.

##### Masės matavimas

[measuringMass.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/skills/measuringMass.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine and interpret the mass of a sample, including appropriate units and the effects of container mass.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Pamatuok mėginio masę atsižvelgdamas į indą ir vienetus.

##### Tūrio matavimas

[measuringVolume.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/skills/measuringVolume.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine liquid or gas volume with suitable measurement conventions and acknowledge instrument limitations.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Matuok skysčių ar dujų tūrį ir suprask prietaisų ribas.

##### Cheminių savybių stebėjimas

[observingChemicalProperties.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/measurementsAndEvidence/skills/observingChemicalProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use age-appropriate, adult-led demonstrations or documented observations (for example, iron rusting or a cut apple browning) to identify visible evidence that a material can undergo a chemical change. Have learners describe what changed, distinguish observations from explanations, and connect the evidence to chemical behavior without expecting explanations of reaction mechanisms. Never ask children to taste, smell, heat, or mix unfamiliar substances.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Pastebėk cheminio pokyčio požymius, pavyzdžiui, kaip rūdija geležis arba paruduoja perpjautas obuolys.

#### Klausimai ir modeliai

Skills: 4

[questionsAndModels.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/questionsAndModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical claims can be examined by specifying substances, observable properties, conditions and possible particle-level explanations.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Išmok kelti ir aiškinti chemijos klausimus remiantis įrodymais ir modeliais.

##### Cheminiai modeliai

[chemicalModels.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/skills/chemicalModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use and critique diagrams, formulas and physical or computational representations according to what they show and omit.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok chemines schemas ir formules suprasdamas jų ribotumą.

##### Chemija kaip mokslo disciplina

[chemistryAsADiscipline.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/skills/chemistryAsADiscipline.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish questions about composition, properties and transformations of matter from neighboring questions about motion, organisms or technological design.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, į kokius klausimus apie medžiagą ir jos pokyčius atsako chemija.

##### Makroskopiniai ir dalelių lygmens paaiškinimai

[macroscopicAndParticleExplanations.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/skills/macroscopicAndParticleExplanations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate an observable change, such as dissolving or gas formation, to a possible account of particles without confusing the model with direct observation.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Susiek matomus cheminius pokyčius su galimais dalelių lygmens paaiškinimais.

##### Patikrinamos cheminės prognozės

[testableChemicalPredictions.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalInquiry/questionsAndModels/skills/testableChemicalPredictions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** State a predicted chemical outcome and the evidence that could support or contradict it.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Pateik patikrinamą prognozę apie cheminį pokytį ir nustatyk ją pagrindžiančius įrodymus.

### Cheminė kalba ir kiekiai

Groups: 3 · Skills: 18

[chemicalLanguageAndQuantities.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemists represent composition and transformation with conventional symbols and use amounts to connect microscopic entities to measurable samples. This domain covers representational and quantitative relationships, not specific reaction mechanisms.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Mokykis simbolių, formulių ir skaičiavimų, kuriais apibūdinamos medžiagos ir reakcijos.

#### Medžiagos kiekis

Skills: 6

[amountOfSubstance.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/amountOfSubstance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The mole and associated quantities link atom-scale counting to bulk mass, volume and reaction proportions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Siek dalelių skaičių su išmatuojamomis masėmis ir reakcijų medžiagos kiekiais.

##### Ribojantys reagentai

[limitingReactants.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/limitingReactants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine which available reactant sets the theoretical upper bound on product formation.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Nustatyk, kuris reagentas riboja didžiausią galimą produkto kiekį.

##### Masės ir molių perskaičiavimas

[massMoleConversion.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/massMoleConversion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Convert between measured mass and amount of substance for a specified chemical entity.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Perskaičiuok medžiagos masę į molius ir atvirkščiai.

##### Molinė masė

[molarMass.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/molarMass.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect formula composition to mass per mole using atomic masses.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok molinę masę, kad susietum cheminę formulę su vieno molio mase.

##### Reakcijos išeiga

[reactionYield.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/reactionYield.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish theoretical yield, observed yield and percentage yield without attributing every shortfall to one cause.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Palygink teorinę ir tikrąją išeigą bei paaiškink procentinę išeigą.

##### Stechiometriniai santykiai

[stoichiometricRatios.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/stoichiometricRatios.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use balanced coefficients to relate amounts of reactants and products.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Remkis išlyginta lygtimi, lygindamas reagentų ir produktų kiekius.

##### Molis

[theMole.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/amountOfSubstance/skills/theMole.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret amount of substance as a count-based quantity defined through Avogadro's constant.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask molį kaip apibrėžtą cheminių dalelių skaičių.

#### Cheminis žymėjimas

Skills: 8

[chemicalNotation.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/chemicalNotation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Symbols and formulas must preserve elemental identity, proportions and charge while being read according to their convention.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip simboliai ir formulės nusako sudėtį bei krūvį.

##### Cheminės formulės

[chemicalFormulas.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/chemicalFormulas.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Read subscripts as composition information rather than reaction coefficients.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kaip apatiniai indeksai nurodo skirtingų atomų santykį.

##### Elementų simboliai

[elementSymbols.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/elementSymbols.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret standard element symbols and distinguish capitalization changes that create different meanings.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Taisyklingai skaityk elementų simbolius, atskirdamas didžiąsias ir mažąsias raides.

##### Empirinės formulės

[empiricalFormulas.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/empiricalFormulas.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Derive or interpret the simplest whole-number elemental ratio without assuming that it specifies one molecule.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Aiškink paprasčiausią sveikųjų skaičių elementų santykį medžiagoje.

##### Neorganinių junginių nomenklatūra

[inorganicNomenclature.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/inorganicNomenclature.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply systematic naming conventions to inorganic compounds, considering ionic or covalent composition and oxidation states where relevant.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Taikyk pavadinimų taisykles neorganiniams junginiams atpažinti.

##### Joninių junginių formulės

[ionicCompoundFormulas.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/ionicCompoundFormulas.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use ion charges to derive electrically neutral formula units.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok jonų krūvius elektriškai neutralių junginių formulėms sudaryti.

##### Molekulinės formulės

[molecularFormulas.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/molecularFormulas.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret how many atoms of each element are present in a specified discrete molecule.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Pagal molekulinę formulę nustatyk vienos molekulės atomus.

##### Organinių junginių nomenklatūra

[organicNomenclature.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/organicNomenclature.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use parent structures, locants and functional groups to relate organic compound names to their molecular connectivity.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Siek sisteminius organinių junginių pavadinimus su molekuline sandara.

##### Oksidacijos laipsniai

[oxidationStates.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/chemicalNotation/skills/oxidationStates.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assign formal oxidation numbers under established conventions without mistaking them for measured atomic charges.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok formalius oksidacijos laipsnius, nepainiodamas jų su tikraisiais krūviais.

#### Reakcijų lygtys

Skills: 4

[reactionEquations.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/reactionEquations/reactionEquations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An equation records reactants, products and stoichiometric relationships but is not, by itself, a mechanism.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip lygtys vaizduoja cheminius virsmus ir medžiagų santykius.

##### Lygčių išlyginimas

[balancingEquations.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/reactionEquations/skills/balancingEquations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose coefficients that conserve the number of each element without altering chemical formulas.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Išlygink cheminę lygtį nekeisdamas formulių.

##### Būsenų simboliai lygtyse

[equationStateSymbols.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/reactionEquations/skills/equationStateSymbols.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret notation for solid, liquid, gas and aqueous species as information about conditions or phases.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Skaityk ženklus, reiškiančius kietąją, skystąją, dujinę ar ištirpusią būseną.

##### Simbolinės lygtys

[symbolicEquations.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/reactionEquations/skills/symbolicEquations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Translate a chemical transformation into formulas with correct reactant and product identities.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Užrašyk teisingas reagentų ir produktų chemines formules.

##### Žodinės lygtys

[wordEquations.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalLanguageAndQuantities/reactionEquations/skills/wordEquations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Represent a described change by naming initial and resulting substances.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Aprašyk reakciją pradinių medžiagų ir produktų pavadinimais.

### Cheminės reakcijos

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[chemicalReactions.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/chemicalReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** This domain identifies and explains transformations in which constituent atoms are rearranged or electron/proton transfer occurs. Chemical equation notation and amount calculations remain in their dedicated domain.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk, kaip reakcijos keičia medžiagas persitvarkant atomams ir perduodant daleles.

#### Oksidacija ir redukcija

Skills: 5

[oxidationAndReduction.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/oxidationAndReduction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Electron bookkeeping describes an important class of reactions even when electrons are not explicitly transferred between discrete ions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk oksidacijos ir redukcijos ryšį su elektronų pokyčiais.

##### Elektrolizė

[electrolysis.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/skills/electrolysis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how externally supplied electrical energy drives non-spontaneous redox reactions at electrodes, including transformations such as electroplating.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kaip elektra skatina savaime nevykstančias reakcijas.

##### Galvaniniai elementai

[galvanicCells.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/skills/galvanicCells.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how spontaneous, spatially separated oxidation and reduction reactions deliver electrical work through an external circuit while charge also flows through the electrolyte.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip atskirtos redokso reakcijos elemente sukuria elektros energiją.

##### Oksidacija

[oxidation.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/skills/oxidation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify increases in formal oxidation state or electron loss in appropriate reaction descriptions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink oksidaciją pagal elektronų netekimą arba oksidacijos laipsnio didėjimą.

##### Oksidacijos–redukcijos poros

[redoxCouples.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/skills/redoxCouples.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate oxidation of one participant to reduction of another and identify oxidizing or reducing agents.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kaip vienas dalyvis oksiduojasi, o kitas redukuojasi.

##### Redukcija

[reduction.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/oxidationAndReduction/skills/reduction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify decreases in formal oxidation state or electron gain in appropriate reaction descriptions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink redukciją pagal elektronų prisijungimą arba oksidacijos laipsnio mažėjimą.

#### Reakcijų tipai

Skills: 6

[reactionPatterns.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/reactionPatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reaction patterns classify transformations such as combination, decomposition, precipitation, displacement, combustion and hydrolysis. Some categories may overlap and do not by themselves determine a detailed reaction mechanism.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok įprastus cheminių reakcijų klasifikavimo būdus.

##### Degimas

[combustion.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/combustion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Characterize reactions with an oxidant that release energy, distinguishing combustion from mere heating.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask degimą kaip reakciją su oksidatoriumi, išskiriančią energiją.

##### Skilimo reakcijos

[decompositionReactions.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/decompositionReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize processes in which one chemical species gives rise to multiple products.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink, kada viena medžiaga skyla į kelis produktus.

##### Pavadavimo reakcijos

[displacementReactions.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/displacementReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reason about when one element can replace another in a compound.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk, kada vienas cheminis elementas junginyje gali pakeisti kitą.

##### Hidrolizė

[hydrolysis.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/hydrolysis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize reactions in which water participates in bond cleavage or chemical conversion.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink reakcijas, kuriose vanduo dalyvauja ardant ar keičiant cheminius ryšius.

##### Nusodinimo reakcijos

[precipitationReactions.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/precipitationReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the formation of an insoluble product from reacting dissolved species.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kodėl reaguojant ištirpusioms medžiagoms susidaro netirpi kietoji medžiaga.

##### Jungimosi reakcijos

[synthesisReactions.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/reactionPatterns/skills/synthesisReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize processes producing a new compound from simpler starting substances.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink, kada paprastesnės medžiagos jungiasi į naują junginį.

#### Reakcijų atpažinimas

Skills: 2

[recognizingReactions.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/recognizingReactions/recognizingReactions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognizing chemical change requires identifying initial and resulting chemical species and examining observations critically rather than treating any visible sign as proof.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip stebėjimai leidžia spręsti, ar įvyko reakcija.

##### Reagentai ir produktai

[reactantsAndProducts.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/recognizingReactions/skills/reactantsAndProducts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify starting and resulting chemical species while distinguishing them from catalysts and solvents.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atskirk pradinius reagentus ir produktus nuo katalizatorių ar tirpiklių.

##### Reakcijų požymiai

[reactionEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemicalReactions/recognizingReactions/skills/reactionEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret gas evolution, precipitates, color changes or thermal effects as possible evidence, with appropriate alternative explanations.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Įvertink, ar burbuliukai, spalvos arba temperatūros pokyčiai rodo cheminę reakciją.

### Chemija mūsų pasaulyje

Groups: 4 · Skills: 20

[chemistryInTheWorld.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/chemistryInTheWorld.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical concepts support understanding of manufactured materials, environmental systems and molecules associated with life. The emphasis is composition, transformation and evidence—not industrial process engineering, clinical advice or organism-level biology.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip chemija aiškina kasdienes medžiagas, aplinką ir gyvybės molekules.

#### Oras ir vanduo

Skills: 5

[airAndWater.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/airAndWater.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Environmental samples contain reacting or partitioning chemical species whose measurements require attention to concentration and chemical form.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk oro ir vandens chemiją, įskaitant teršalus ir ištirpusias medžiagas.

##### Cheminiai pokyčiai atmosferoje

[atmosphericChemicalChanges.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/skills/atmosphericChemicalChanges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate pollutant reactions and transformations to phenomena such as acid deposition or photochemical smog.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Susiek atmosferos reakcijas su smogu ir rūgščiąja depozicija.

##### Anglies chemija aplinkoje

[carbonChemistryInTheEnvironment.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/skills/carbonChemistryInTheEnvironment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Track carbon among carbon dioxide, dissolved carbonate species and organic matter without conflating chemistry with whole-ecosystem modeling.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sek anglį anglies diokside, ištirpusiuose anglies junginiuose ir organinėje medžiagoje.

##### Oro sudėtis

[compositionOfAir.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/skills/compositionOfAir.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish major atmospheric components from variable traces and pollutants.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink pagrindines oro dujas ir atskirk jas nuo labai mažo kiekio teršalų.

##### Vanduo kaip tirpiklis

[waterAsASolvent.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/skills/waterAsASolvent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain polarity and hydrogen bonding behind water's distinctive solvent behavior.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk, kodėl molekulinės sąveikos leidžia vandeniui tirpinti daugelį medžiagų.

##### Vandens teršalai

[waterContaminants.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/airAndWater/skills/waterContaminants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify dissolved and particulate contaminants by chemical identity and behavior without assuming visible clarity proves safety.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink įvairius vandens teršalus ir nemanyk, kad skaidrus vanduo būtinai saugus.

#### Medžiagų chemija

Skills: 7

[materialsChemistry.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/chemistryInTheWorld/materialsChemistry/materialsChemistry.data.ts)

### Energija, greitis ir pusiausvyra

Groups: 3 · Skills: 19

[energyRatesAndEquilibrium.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/energyRatesAndEquilibrium/energyRatesAndEquilibrium.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemical systems exchange energy, evolve at finite rates and may approach dynamic equilibrium. These are related but distinct questions: whether change is favorable, how quickly it occurs and what composition persists.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Tyrinėk energijos pokyčius, reakcijų greitį ir tiesioginių bei atvirkštinių reakcijų pusiausvyrą.

Skills: 8

**Methodological description (English):** Energy changes are properties of a system and its processes, not intrinsic fuel labels or a claim that breaking bonds alone releases energy.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Įvertink šilumos perdavimą pagal temperatūros pokytį, atsižvelgdamas į nuostolius.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink šilumą sugeriančius procesus, nemanydamas, kad jie negali vykti.

[gases.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/particlesAndStates/phasesAndTransitions/skills/gases.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate compressibility and expansion to widely spaced particles and their motion.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kodėl dujos plečiasi ir gali būti suspaudžiamos.

##### Skysčiai

[liquids.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/particlesAndStates/phasesAndTransitions/skills/liquids.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate flow and nearly fixed volume to mobile particles that remain close together.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip arti viena kitos esančios judrios dalelės leidžia skysčiams tekėti.

##### Lydymasis

[melting.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/particlesAndStates/phasesAndTransitions/skills/melting.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a solid becomes liquid under appropriate temperature and pressure conditions, without requiring a change in chemical identity.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kaip kietoji medžiaga virsta skysčiu netapdama nauja medžiaga.

##### Kietosios medžiagos

[solids.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/particlesAndStates/phasesAndTransitions/skills/solids.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate stable shape and structure to constrained particle motion without assuming every solid is crystalline.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kodėl kietosios medžiagos išlaiko formą, nors jų dalelės nuolat juda.

##### Sublimacija

[sublimation.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/particlesAndStates/phasesAndTransitions/skills/sublimation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain direct conversion from solid to vapor without passage through a bulk liquid phase.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink, kaip kai kurios kietosios medžiagos tiesiogiai virsta garais, nevirsdamos skysčiu.

##### Garavimas

[vaporization.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/particlesAndStates/phasesAndTransitions/skills/vaporization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain transformation of liquid to gas, distinguishing surface evaporation from boiling within a liquid under suitable pressure.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atskirk garavimą nuo skysčio paviršiaus ir virimą visame skystyje.

### Medžiagos ir jų savybės

Groups: 3 · Skills: 11

[substancesAndProperties.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/substancesAndProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Chemists classify samples by composition and characterize them through reproducible properties. This domain focuses on observable and bulk descriptions before explaining them through atomic structure or bonding.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Sužinok, kaip chemikai atpažįsta medžiagas pagal sudėtį, savybes ir pokyčius.

#### Pokyčiai ir tvermė

Skills: 3

[changesAndConservation.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/changesAndConservation/changesAndConservation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Changes in form and changes in composition are distinct, while matter is conserved in appropriately defined systems.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atskirk medžiagos pokyčius nuo naujų medžiagų susidarymo.

##### Cheminiai pokyčiai

[chemicalChanges.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/changesAndConservation/skills/chemicalChanges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the formation of new substances, distinguishing reaction evidence from suggestive but inconclusive visual signs.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Remkis tinkamais įrodymais nustatydamas, ar įvyko cheminė reakcija.

##### Masės tvermė

[massConservation.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/changesAndConservation/skills/massConservation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Account for matter in physical and chemical processes, including gases that cross an open-system boundary.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Paaiškink masės tvermę atsižvelgdamas ir į dujų masę, patenkančią į atvirą sistemą ar iš jos išeinančią.

##### Fizikiniai pokyčiai

[physicalChanges.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/changesAndConservation/skills/physicalChanges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize changes in form or phase that do not by themselves establish a different chemical identity.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink lydymąsi, pjaustymą ir kitus pokyčius, išsaugančius cheminį tapatumą.

#### Būdingosios savybės

Skills: 4

[characteristicProperties.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/characteristicProperties/characteristicProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Physical and chemical properties supply different evidence about substances, and measurements are meaningful only under stated conditions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Išsiaiškink matuojamas savybes, padedančias apibūdinti ir atpažinti medžiagas.

##### Cheminės savybės

[chemicalProperties.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/characteristicProperties/skills/chemicalProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how reactivity or resistance to chemical change characterizes a substance under specified conditions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Suprask, kaip medžiagos reaktyvumas apibūdina jos chemines savybes.

##### Tankis

[density.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/characteristicProperties/skills/density.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sample mass and volume to an intensive property and use it to distinguish plausible materials.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Naudok masę ir tūrį medžiagos tankiui suprasti.

##### Fizikinės savybės

[physicalProperties.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/characteristicProperties/skills/physicalProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use density, conductivity, hardness, melting point or other properties that do not require changing chemical identity.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink savybes, kurias galima išmatuoti nekeičiant cheminės medžiagos tapatybės.

##### Atpažinimas pagal savybes

[propertyBasedIdentification.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/characteristicProperties/skills/propertyBasedIdentification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare multiple measured properties with reference information while acknowledging that one matching property may be insufficient.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Palygink kelias išmatuotas savybes galimai medžiagai nustatyti.

#### Sudėtis

Skills: 4

[composition.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/composition/composition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A specimen may be a single chemical substance or a combination of substances; its everyday name does not establish its composition.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Išmok atskirti vieną medžiagą nuo skirtingų medžiagų derinio.

##### Elementai ir junginiai

[elementsAndCompounds.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/composition/skills/elementsAndCompounds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish matter containing one element from substances whose constituent elements occur in fixed chemical proportions.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atskirk cheminius elementus nuo junginių, sudarytų iš skirtingų elementų.

##### Vienalyčiai ir nevienalyčiai mėginiai

[homogeneousAndHeterogeneousSamples.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/composition/skills/homogeneousAndHeterogeneousSamples.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify samples by whether their composition and phases are uniform at the relevant scale.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Nustatyk, ar mėginys vienodas, ar turi skirtingų dalių ar fazių.

##### Mišiniai

[mixtures.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/composition/skills/mixtures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize combinations whose component proportions can vary without making a new substance.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink mišinius, kurių komponentai gali būti įvairiomis proporcijomis.

##### Grynosios medžiagos

[pureSubstances.data.ts](../../../content/chemistry/data/skills/substancesAndProperties/composition/skills/pureSubstances.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish a chemically defined substance from a sample containing additional components, even when the sample appears uniform.

**User-friendly description (lt):** Atpažink, ar mėginys yra viena grynoji medžiaga, o ne mišinys.
